decisions.reason: Requesting a draft copyright-transfer certificate for wording review does not change the requirement that the logo artwork be original and trademark-suitable.
The certificate wording review is unrelated to whether delivered PNG logo files open and display properly.
The copyright certificate request does not alter the flame-based letter O or its recognition requirement.
Reviewing a draft ownership certificate does not change the completed initial-concept obligation or the role of reference material.
The requested copyright certificate template does not modify the obligation to provide complementary brand-font guidance.
The certificate wording acceptance condition has no effect on the required full-colour, black, and white logo variants.
The copyright-transfer certificate request does not change the separate disclosure of whether the logo lettering is custom-made or font-based.
The word 'wording' in the source refers to certificate language, not the company name or words displayed in the logo.
The ownership-certificate review does not alter the requirement to include the existing strapline in the logo.
The draft certificate request does not affect the delivery or contents of the brand colour specification.
The certificate wording review does not change any approved colour treatment within the final logo.
Requesting a draft copyright certificate does not modify the requirement to deliver fully editable logo source files.
